sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:73

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:73:1
items.html:
There was yet another change, etc.: He informs us here that two essential corrections were needed for the completion of the vessels, such that the lower ones would be able to receive the upper light: first, the correction of the three lines; second, the enlargement of the vessels in the secret of a Partzuf. Now, in the Gufim of the ten Sefirot of AK, which are called Akudim, there was only one vessel and one line. After this, when the MA and BON of AK came out, which are called Nekudim, or BON of AK, ten vessels came out, and also the correction of the lines in the GAR of Nekudim. And after HGT broke and the Rosh [head] of YESHSUT came out, the correction of the lines was made in the lights of HGT.
And after Netzah, Hod, Yesod and Malchut broke, and the coupling of the five Hassadim and the five Gevurot of Daat came out, the correction of the lines was made also in the lights of NHY of Nekudim. And the matter of Ibur [impregnation], nursing and Mochin will be explained in its place.
